acceptanceCriteria: Spec with numbered requirements for identity matching, per-test verdicts, assertion-origin separation and the overall verdict.
Focused fixture tests: identical runs -> PARITY; changed assertion -> DIVERGED; mismatched configs or missing inputs -> INCOMPARABLE; fixture-only assertion difference reported as fixture difference.
body:
Source: GitHub beamfall/corvint#797.

Read-only producer (e.g. `corvint runs compare --baseline A.json[,..] --candidate B.json[,..]`) over Playwright JSON reports: match tests by stable identity (project, file, title path); per test report outcome, retry and the set of failed assertion steps (matcher + location) with SAME/CHANGED/MISSING/NEW; separate test-file assertions from page-object/helper/fixture assertions; report per-run resource facts already in the report (worker indexes, fixture durations, cleanup outcome); emit one machine-readable verdict PARITY/DIVERGED/INCOMPARABLE with reasons. Optional N repeats per side with k/N stability.
